_README: Production configuration. Secret values (ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection, JwtSettings:SecretKey, EmailSettings:Email/Password) are NOT overridden here so they are inherited from appsettings.json. Where a hosting environment supports it, override them with environment variables (section separator '__'), e.g. ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, JwtSettings__SecretKey, EmailSettings__Password. Do NOT re-introduce empty-string values for these keys: an empty string overrides the base value and makes the app fail to start (HTTP 500.30).
_README_AdminUser: The AdminUser section is deliberately absent here, and absent from appsettings.json. IdentityDataSeeder has no built-in fallback credentials: with the section unset it only ensures the 'Admin' role exists and seeds no account, so the local development administrator (see appsettings.Development.json) can never appear in Production. Existing administrators are unaffected. To bootstrap an administrator on a fresh Production database, set AdminUser__UserName, AdminUser__Email and AdminUser__Password as environment variables (never in a committed file), start the app once, then remove them.
